You can now listen to Works in Progress articles. The mellifluous voice of Stuart Richie, who you may recognize from the podcast Science Fictions [ https://substack.com/redirect/69853dfc-395b-4ca0-82e1-369e0d65d2be?j=eyJ1IjoiOG81NG4ifQ.6oeetudtJEh-zO1onUJvtadWEdbodFIw0h4xbugrh1o ], will be bringing you a new article every week. We’re starting today with Two is already too many [ https://substack.com/redirect/d452916e-d4dc-42bf-a8df-05bb5c186551?j=eyJ1IjoiOG81NG4ifQ.6oeetudtJEh-zO1onUJvtadWEdbodFIw0h4xbugrh1o ], a piece from Issue 21 about why South Korean fertility rates are so low, by Phoebe Arslanagic-Little.
We’ll be publishing a mix of new articles and pieces from the back catalogue. You can find them on the main Works in Progress podcast feed on Apple [ https://substack.com/redirect/70cafbbe-4f45-4975-af3d-8524090b3b3d?j=eyJ1IjoiOG81NG4ifQ.6oeetudtJEh-zO1onUJvtadWEdbodFIw0h4xbugrh1o ] and Spotify [ https://substack.com/redirect/31b9a7c3-7258-49c3-93ce-1591e67bd5b0?j=eyJ1IjoiOG81NG4ifQ.6oeetudtJEh-zO1onUJvtadWEdbodFIw0h4xbugrh1o ], our YouTube [ https://substack.com/redirect/d9dfd0ce-51cc-4eef-abab-97e32e00d378?j=eyJ1IjoiOG81NG4ifQ.6oeetudtJEh-zO1onUJvtadWEdbodFIw0h4xbugrh1o ] channel, and as a new section [ https://substack.com/redirect/6a816d4a-3bc9-435e-91d5-d31438bb8b74?j=eyJ1IjoiOG81NG4ifQ.6oeetudtJEh-zO1onUJvtadWEdbodFIw0h4xbugrh1o ] on our Substack.
